mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_id,vendor_id,status,shipping_fee_status,shipping_fee,buyer_deposit_status,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agreed_json,'$.pricing_version')) AS pricing_version FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET buyer_deposit=buyer_deposit+#{fee},agreed_json=JSON_SET(agreed_json,'$.shipping_escrow',#{fee},'$.buyer_escrow',buyer_deposit),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND buyer_deposit_status='frozen'
UPDATE t_deposits SET amount=amount+#{fee},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE order_id=#{id} AND payer_id=#{buyer} AND party_role='buyer' AND kind='buyer_escrow' AND status='frozen'

UPDATE t_orders SET shipping_fee=#{fee},shipping_fee_note=#{note},shipping_fee_status='proposed',shipping_fee_deadline=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 24 HOUR),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE t_orders SET shipping_fee=#{fee},shipping_fee_status='countered',shipping_fee_note=CONCAT('买家反提：',COALESCE(shipping_fee_note,'')),shipping_fee_deadline=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 24 HOUR),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}
